name: Amunet
abilities: Secret Name — marks target, next attack teleports behind them for bonus damage
passives: Solar Edict: Amunet gains Solar Charge — Build by burst damage — every critical hit or backstab generates 1 stack. At 3 stacks: Next ability deals +50% damage. At 5 stacks: Ultimate cooldown reduced 30%. Max 5 stacks. Damage escalation — the more you fight, the stronger your strikes.
lore: Amunet, Hidden Breath Goddess, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Aten Ra. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: hidden wind and unseen name goddess, concealed solar breath, secret execution. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses hidden wind and unseen name goddess, concealed solar breath, secret execution; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Aten Ra canon.
visualDescription: Amunet manifests as hidden wind and unseen name goddess, concealed solar breath, secret execution from Aten Ra: alluring feminine hidden-sun face, narrow luminous eyes, delicate nose, knowing half-smile behind translucent veil; slender feminine dancer-assassin physique, narrow shoulders, lithe hips, silent coiled posture; signature silhouette: veiled crown, trailing ribbons, twin low blades, almost-vanishing profile. Weapon: paired obsidian name-knives carried in veiled hands. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Amunet — Ma’at-Weighted Strike Execution
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Aten Ra source-culture damage at range 1; generate Momentum and a small Solar Charge gain when used from Aten-lit judgment ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Pylon Edict Technique — Shadow Pursuit
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Builds Solar Charge only when the Avatar uses Aten-lit judgment ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Amunet: Sun-Scale Decree Final Name Cut
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to impose a two-round rule from Solar Dominion of Khepra: hunts marked targets, erases escape routes, and creates a precise execution window with recovery risk. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Aten-Ra Source Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Solar Charge, transform nearby terrain into Aten-lit judgment ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Amunet Name-Knife Ma’at Was-Sceptre Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through Aten-lit judgment ground. Visual: Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Amunet Electrum Wesekh Source-Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Amunet Khepri Solar Scarab Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Solar Charge and unlocks a mastery branch for Aten Hand-Ray Gate Step, Uraeus Counter-Edict, and Weigh the Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: execute priority targets and reposition through danger
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Amunet's Solar Edict: a solo mechanic where Solar Charge grows through Aten-lit judgment ground, reaction-window mastery, and assassin decisions that set a vulnerability omen, then cash it out through execution timing. Payoff: delete priority threats only after readable setup and risk. Counterplay: reveal effects, armor spikes, or missed execution windows punish greed; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: reveal effects, armor spikes, or missed execution windows punish greed
